thesis: Okta disclosed fiscal-Q2 revenue growth of 11%, subscription growth of 12%, current remaining performance obligations growth of 14%, GAAP operating margin of 13% versus 6% a year earlier, and non-GAAP free cash flow of $227 million. This suggests improving backlog and operating leverage support a long thesis. The strongest counter-evidence is full-year revenue guidance of only 10% to 11% growth and fiscal-Q3 non-GAAP operating-margin guidance of 24% to 25% versus 28% in fiscal Q2; accelerating current RPO, the higher GAAP margin, and improved free-cash-flow margin outweigh that near-term moderation. The latest available Form 10-Q reported no material legal matters, and targeted checks found no qualifying scheduled litigation step or three-year governance event.
invalidation: Current RPO growth reverses materially, GAAP operating margin falls back toward the prior-year level, or a material security or legal event undermines customer retention before the next review.

thesis: Veeva disclosed fiscal-Q2 revenue growth of 18%, subscription growth of 16%, GAAP operating-income growth of 40%, and an improved full-year outlook, while Vault CRM reached more than 180 live customers and 12 top-20-biopharma commitments. This suggests broad product adoption and operating leverage support a long thesis. The strongest counter-evidence is execution risk in the Vault CRM migration, customer concentration, and rising competition; that does not change the read because the confirmed quarter exceeded company guidance across metrics and commitments broadened while GAAP operating income grew faster than revenue. The latest available Form 10-Q reported no material legal proceedings, and targeted checks found no qualifying scheduled litigation step or three-year governance event.
invalidation: The company cuts its full-year revenue or non-GAAP operating-income outlook, Vault CRM loses major customer commitments, or GAAP operating-income growth falls below revenue growth without a one-time explanation.

thesis: Harmony Gold disclosed fiscal-2026 gold production within guidance, all-in sustaining cost within guidance, headline earnings growth of 87%, record adjusted non-GAAP free cash flow growth of 54%, and a materially higher final dividend, while the acquired CSA mine added copper production. This suggests strong cash generation and diversification support a long thesis. The strongest counter-evidence is a 3% decline in gold production, a 22% increase in all-in sustaining cost, lower fiscal-2027 gold-production guidance, and higher cost guidance; those pressures are only narrowly outweighed by the confirmed earnings, cash-flow, payout, and copper contribution. Harmony also confirmed prior-period restatements caused by mine-planning-software configuration and payroll/accrual errors, which triggers governance_history; targeted checks found no qualifying scheduled litigation step in the next roughly 90 days.
invalidation: Additional restatement errors emerge, the auditor modifies its conclusion, fiscal-2027 production falls below guidance, all-in sustaining cost exceeds the guidance ceiling, or CSA misses its disclosed copper volume or cost ranges.
